race.title: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: GENTLEMAN TOBOOT looks well treated on his strong novice hurdle form and appeals most at the prices. Dan Skelton's Moneygarrow will rightly be popular in the market, and he's feared most ahead of strong-travelling Spirits Bay . Court In The Act and A King Of Magic complete the shortlist for this competitive renewal. GENTLEMAN TOBOOT (IRE) MONEYGARROW (IRE) SPIRITS BAY
